_note: K8: Mirage map knowledge (docs/coach/strategy.md). Every place name a demo reports (last_place_name) belongs to exactly one zone; lanes list the places Ts walk through toward a site; counters are what the advice text quotes.

lanes.name: A Ramp
counters: Hold Ramp from Tetris or Triple with a teammate close enough to trade, not from the open middle of the site.
When you hear them gather at the bottom of Ramp, a molotov or HE on the Ramp exit buys the time for a rotation.

lanes.name: Palace
counters: Hold the Palace exit from Firebox or Ticket, off the angle they pre-aim, and fall back after the first contact.
A molotov on the Palace exit when you hear feet stops a fast take; keep one flash for the retake.

lanes.name: Mid, Window and Connector
counters: Contest Mid early from Window or Connector with an AWP or a smoke at Top Mid, then give it up before the flashes come.
Once they own Mid, keep a player in Connector or Jungle with a flash ready, so a Connector split cannot walk into A unseen.

lanes.name: Short
counters: Hold Short from Market window or the Bench corner and call it the moment you see one, so B can rotate.
A molotov on Short when they stack at Ladder room delays a B split by the seconds a rotation needs.

lanes.name: Underpass
counters: Underpass is the back door into Mid and Short: a quick early peek for information, then hold it from Short with a teammate.
A molotov down the Underpass stairs when you hear them stops a lurk from cutting off the B rotation.

lanes.name: Apartments
counters: Hold the Apartments exit from Van or Bench, not from the open site, and fall back to Market when the flashes come.
A molotov on the Apartments exit plus a flash over it stops a rush; an early info push into Apartments needs a teammate to trade.
